The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerningElam , in the beginning of the reign ofZedekiah king of Judah .
Thus says the Lord of hosts : “ Behold , I will breakthe bow ofElam , the mainstay of their might .
And I will bring uponElam the four winds from the four quarters of heaven . And I will scatter them to all those winds , and there shall be no nation to which those driven out ofElam shall not come .

I willterrifyElam before their enemies and before those who seek their life . I will bring disaster upon them ,my fierce anger , declares the Lord .I will send the sword after them , until I have consumed them ,
